description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and an unspecified metric across four different categories: Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files. The x-axis represents the number of tokens, with a linear scale ranging from 200 to 900, marked at intervals of 200. The y-axis is unlabeled but has a linear scale from 10 to 40, marked at intervals of 10. The plot features four lines, each corresponding to a category: Tutorials (blue, solid line, circle markers), Library Documentation (red, solid line, circle markers), StackOverflow posts (yellow, solid line, circle markers), and Github files (green, solid line, circle markers). The blue line (Tutorials) starts at approximately 23 on the y-axis at 200 tokens and increases to around 30 at 800 tokens before slightly decreasing to 29 at 900 tokens. The red line (Library Documentation) begins at about 25 at 200 tokens, rises to 31 at 800 tokens, and then drops to 28 at 900 tokens. The yellow line (StackOverflow posts) starts high at around 32 at 200 tokens, gradually decreases to 20 at 700 tokens, and then sharply drops to 11 at 900 tokens. The green line (Github files) starts at approximately 29 at 200 tokens, peaks at 32 at 800 tokens, and then decreases to 28 at 900 tokens.
